name: SvelteKit & Vite Fullstack
description: Reactive UI architecture, server-side rendering, adapter deployment, and type-safe routing with SvelteKit.
best_practices: Runes & Reactivity: Leverage Svelte 5 runes ($state, $derived, $effect) for explicit, fine-grained reactivity and predictable state lifecycles.
Server load functions: Place sensitive business logic, database queries, and private API keys in server-only load functions (+page.server.ts) rather than client modules.
Progressive enhancement: Implement standard HTML form actions with use:enhance for seamless client-side interactivity that degrades gracefully.
Layout inheritance: Structure routes with hierarchical +layout.svelte files for shared UI and persistent navigation state without layout remounting.
